set.body: Expose connectivity node and edge finite spaces without replacing VertexBasis or vectorization provenance; adapt EdgeMask to region semantics; rename the scored threshold Region and back compact/full-grid support with exact maps; reuse locus selections and maps for latent active/full-grid transport while keeping representation policies. Acceptance follows phase 10 of docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md and focused JVM and Scala.js gates.
set.title: Locus 10: adapt connectivity, threshold, and latent consumers
